usageNotes: Use this to bulk-evacuate all (or a filtered subset of) VMs and containers off a node — typically before maintenance, hardware replacement, or decommissioning. Either 'max-workers' must be specified or 'max_workers' must be set in datacenter.cfg; the call will fail if neither is configured. The endpoint returns a UPID string for an async task; poll the task status via the node tasks API to confirm completion before powering off or removing the source node.

examples.summary: Evacuate all guests from pve-node1 to pve-node2 with up to 3 parallel migrations, including guests with local disks

tips: Omit 'vms' to migrate everything on the node; pass a comma-separated VMID list to migrate only specific guests.
Use 'max-workers' (not the deprecated 'maxworkers') for new automation — one of the two must be set or the API returns an error.
'with-local-disks' triggers live storage migration; without it, guests using only local storage will be skipped or fail to migrate.
Running guests are live-migrated if the storage is compatible; stopped guests are cold-migrated regardless.
The returned UPID can be checked with GET /nodes/{node}/tasks/{upid}/status to monitor progress.
